queries: WITH name_averages AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS average_amount FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.event_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS mean_average FROM name_averages) SELECT n.event_name, n.average_amount, n.average_amount - o.mean_average AS amount_above_mean, n.average_amount / NULLIF(o.mean_average, 0) AS ratio_to_mean FROM name_averages AS n CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE n.average_amount > o.mean_average

WITH name_averages AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS average_amount FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.event_name), comparison AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS mean_average FROM name_averages) SELECT n.event_name, n.average_amount, n.average_amount - c.mean_average AS amount_above_mean, n.average_amount / NULLIF(c.mean_average, 0) AS ratio_to_mean FROM name_averages AS n CROSS JOIN comparison AS c WHERE n.average_amount > c.mean_average;

WITH per_name AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS average_budgeted_amount FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.amount IS NOT NULL AND e.event_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.event_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_budgeted_amount) AS mean_of_averages FROM per_name) SELECT p.event_name, p.average_budgeted_amount, p.average_budgeted_amount - o.mean_of_averages AS amount_above_mean, p.average_budgeted_amount / NULLIF(o.mean_of_averages, 0) AS ratio_to_mean FROM per_name AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.average_budgeted_amount > o.mean_of_averages;

responses.sql: WITH name_averages AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS average_amount FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.event_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS mean_average FROM name_averages) SELECT n.event_name, n.average_amount, n.average_amount - o.mean_average AS amount_above_mean, n.average_amount / NULLIF(o.mean_average, 0) AS ratio_to_mean FROM name_averages AS n CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE n.average_amount > o.mean_average

assumptions.assumption: A NULL event_name is excluded because it does not identify an event name. The ratio is NULL if the mean is zero.

responses.sql: WITH name_averages AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS average_amount FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.event_name), comparison AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS mean_average FROM name_averages) SELECT n.event_name, n.average_amount, n.average_amount - c.mean_average AS amount_above_mean, n.average_amount / NULLIF(c.mean_average, 0) AS ratio_to_mean FROM name_averages AS n CROSS JOIN comparison AS c WHERE n.average_amount > c.mean_average;

assumptions.assumption: A NULL event_name is not an event name and is excluded. If the mean of the averages is zero, the ratio is NULL.

responses.sql: WITH per_name AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS average_budgeted_amount FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.amount IS NOT NULL AND e.event_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.event_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_budgeted_amount) AS mean_of_averages FROM per_name) SELECT p.event_name, p.average_budgeted_amount, p.average_budgeted_amount - o.mean_of_averages AS amount_above_mean, p.average_budgeted_amount / NULLIF(o.mean_of_averages, 0) AS ratio_to_mean FROM per_name AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.average_budgeted_amount > o.mean_of_averages;

assumptions.assumption: Rows with a missing event name are excluded because they cannot identify an event name; a ratio with a zero denominator is NULL.
